name: Æ TWA — Fusion ÆI + ÆEA
description: Lossless fusion of ÆI (GAIA/ÆI seed) and ÆEA (MT4-parity market engine) as a Telegram Mini App. One ordered market feed advances both engines: the ÆEA bar ring (13 normalised indicators + Ichimoku → m/n/δ → regime → BB×58 → 𝒫_arc → signal iff δ-gate → orders/trailing/FVG) and the ÆI seed (prime → outward Λ₂₄ → Hopf → s²=r² → DbZ → I → SelfEvolution), with x lifted from the same tick as abs(price-prevPrice)/10000 (or 1/100 on zero). MarketTickWorker is relay-first (fused worker.js ?symbol= route, then Kraken direct, then synthetic), so both worker routes (crawler ?url= and market ?symbol=) are consumed end-to-end. All seed values are exact Fractions; the backend is authoritative when connected. CS-translated UI throughout. Version: Final, First edition.

TELEGRAM_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of the Telegram Mini App (GitHub Pages URL). Skips tunnel spawn when set.

RELAY_URL.description: Cloudflare Worker relay URL (deployed from the aei-relay repo). Required for both crawler and market data.

RELAY_KEY.description: Optional shared secret matching `wrangler secret put RELAY_KEY` in the aei-relay repo.

REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Enforce X-Telegram-Init-Data on all non-/health endpoints. Defaults to '1'.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Lock down writes to your GitHub Pages origin. Defaults to '*'.

SEED_TICK_INTERVAL.description: Seed loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '5'.

CRAWL_INTERVAL.description: Crawler loop interval in seconds. Defaults to '3'.

MAX_CRAWL_DEPTH.description: Maximum crawl recursion depth. Defaults to '3'.

LOG_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /log endpoint. Defaults to '1000'.

TOAST_BUFFER_SIZE.description: Ring-buffer size for the /toasts endpoint. Defaults to '500'.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs. Empty = open bot. For a private deployment, put your own user ID (from /whoami).
